div.div:
خُلُجٌ (assumed tropical:) Persons trembling in the bodies. (K.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) Persons tired, or fatigued. (IAar.) ―
-b3- (assumed tropical:) A people whose lineage, or origin, is doubted, (T, K,) so that different persons dispute, one with another, respecting it. (T.) See also مُخْتَلَجٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
